Name: Veltrysinib Alpha
Mechanism: Selective allosteric/hinge WEE1 inhibitor; forces immediate mitotic catastrophe in G2/M-dependent aneuploid tumor clones while sparing healthy diploid cells.

Name: Mitotectin Beta
Mechanism: Allosteric rescuer of kinetochore tension; stabilizes the mitotic checkpoint complex signaling in the presence of hypomorphic BUB1B variants.

Name: Senol-PROTAC CRBN
Mechanism: Platelet-sparing targeted chimeric degrader; selectively eliminates BCL-xL in senescent somatic cells while sparing anucleated platelets lacking CRBN.

Name: Senol-PROTAC VHL
Mechanism: VHL-directed BCL-xL degrader optimizing renal clearance and preventing medullary interstitial fibrosis.

Name: Kinetochorin Alpha
Mechanism: Allosteric mechano-chemical chaperone stabilizing the neck-linker of CENPE to restore processive motility.

Name: Micronucleocin A
Mechanism: Active-site competitive inhibitor of cGAS; completely halts cGAMP synthesis from micronuclear DNA leakage.

Name: Aneuprecin-1 (Axo-Pept 1)
Mechanism: Bio-inspired 19-aa peptide; selectively permeabilizes aneuploid neoplastic membranes and upregulates SFN/RB1/BRCA1.

Name: pegRNA-ABE8e Prime/Base Editor
Mechanism: High-efficiency ABE8e/Prime Editing duplex achieving single-nucleotide reversion of CENPE and WT1 without double-strand DNA cleavage.
